title: Two-sided power-filtration coinvariant growth in canonical dimension for nonzero modules over uniform pro-p Iwasawa algebras
source_title: On the density of supercuspidal points of fixed regular weight in local deformation rings and global Hecke algebras
author: Matthew Emerton; Vytautas Paškūnas
difficulty_reason: The noncommutative Iwasawa canonical dimension is identified with the commutative associated-graded Krull dimension. A Frobenius-ideal filtration sandwiches genuine group coinvariants between Hilbert-Samuel and Hilbert-Kunz lengths, giving a sharp exponential exponent for the specified uniform power tower.
